chapter: Big band, Chicago players, recordings and gospel
title: Other Okeh sides with Joe Williams
summary: He lists Stop Pretty Baby, Lying Girl Blues and Mistreating Woman Blues, pushing Joe Williams.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well, what were some of the other things that you did?
Then I made a tune called 'Stop, Pretty Baby.' This was with Joe Williams -- 'Lying Girl Blues,' 'Mistreating Woman Blues,' all of these things. We made quite a few
I think some of those are available on European re-issues.
I wouldn't be surprised, I wouldn't be surprised, yeah.
Right. I had some of the records up here, but they're all the 78s.
